note: pow(x, y) oracle rows [x, y, generic, fma] as IEEE-754 bits. generic: musl's pow (the same ARM optimized-routines code as glibc's generic build) compiled to WASM by emscripten. fma: glibc's x86-64 FMA build (the host libm on an FMA+AVX2 CPU, read through gawk's ^ operator, which calls pow()). Rows are every input in x=2..200000 (y=-1.5) and in 100000 random (x, y) pairs where the two builds disagree, plus a sample where they agree.
